about_the_game:
DISCLAIMER

IDILI is a 0.1 Alpha prototype that's still under development and does not represent the final quality of the game. We will continuously work to improve it and update with new content.

THE STORY

John accompanies Nora to Sardinia, where she has been temporarily assigned as an archaeologist at the Isili Archaeological Park. During the night of the summer solstice, on the occasion of the rare alignment of the sun with the Nuraghi in the park, Nora and her colleague Nicola are summoned by their company, the Lithus Corporation, to carry out a specific task. But after that expedition, they never return.

Worried, John decides to venture into the ruins to look for her. In the silence of the park, the light fades and the atmosphere grows increasingly oppressive: something is moving in the shadows. To survive, he will have to remain quiet and endure a mounting sense of claustrophobia, as an ancient creature begins to hunt him.

To find Nora and escape, John must confront not only the threat lurking in the park, but also his deepest fears and the dark secrets of Lithus, secrets entwined with his fate, with Nora’s, and with that of the place itself.

THE SETTING

Brave the horror of the Sardinian myths and legends as you try to survive and solve ancient mysteries in this original First-Person Horror experience set in the context of the Mediterranean island of Sardinia.

IDILI aims to bring the evocative landscape of Sardinia to life. The Archeologic Park of Is Paras is inspired by a real place in the village of Isili in the heart of Sardinia's south (you can visit it, for real!).

All of the cultural and archeologically significant places and artefacts are heavily inspired by their real world counter parts and were meticulously handcrafted by the team.

THE TEAM

Megalith Interactive Studios is a young team made up of people with no specific experience in the world of the video game industry. We are passionate, independent and zero budget.

IDILI is the result of a common effort and with it we want to show our skills and try to enter the world of video games with a project that comes out in early access because it wants to be much more than what will come out as the first release.

The assets that make up the game map, as all of the other elements of the game, are 100% original, except for a part of the vegetation, and for this we are very proud as the archaeology and the places of culture and tradition shown in the game try to be a faithful reproduction of the original counterpart.

content_descriptors.notes: IDILI is a horror game. You get hunted by a monster and the design of the monster is body horror. When the monster catches you there will be multiple animations where the player dies in different gruesome ways.

  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: IDILI is a first-person Survival Horror video game. Discover Sardinian tradition and experience its terrifying legends as they come to life in your hands. Investigate, explore, escape. You will have to survive with all your strength to uncover its secrets.
supported_languages:
English*, Italian
*languages with full audio support
